import os
def read_file(filename):
    base = os.path.realpath("/var/data")
    target = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(base, filename))
    if os.path.commonpath([base, target]) != base:
        raise ValueError("invalid path")
    with open(target) as f:
        return f.read()

import requests
from urllib.parse import urlparse
ALLOWED_HOSTS = {"docs.example.com", "status.example.com"}
def fetch_url(user_url):
    parts = urlparse(user_url)
    if parts.scheme != "https" or parts.hostname not in ALLOWED_HOSTS or parts.port not in (None, 443):
        raise ValueError("host not allowed")
    return requests.get(user_url, timeout=10, allow_redirects=False).text
